features: COMPATIBLE MODELS: Designed to fit Kobo Libra 2 and Kobo Libra Colour e-readers perfectly.
PU LEATHER CONSTRUCTION: Crafted from durable PU leather for a premium look and feel.
SOLID BLACK DESIGN: Features a sleek, solid black colour for a clean and professional appearance.
FULL PROTECTION: The cover shields your e-reader from scratches, dust, and everyday wear and tear.
LIGHTWEIGHT AND SLIM: Adds minimal bulk while keeping your device safe and easy to carry.
description: The Koverra PU Leather Case in classic black is a sleek and stylish protective cover designed specifically for the Kobo Libra 2 and Kobo Libra Colour e-readers. Crafted from quality PU leather, this solid colour case offers a sophisticated look while keeping your device safe from everyday scratches, dust, and minor bumps. The precise cut-outs ensure easy access to all buttons and ports, so you can enjoy a seamless reading experience without removing the cover. The slim and lightweight design adds minimal bulk to your e-reader, making it convenient to carry in your bag or hold during long reading sessions. The interior lining provides a snug fit, holding your Kobo securely in place at all times. Whether you are commuting, travelling, or relaxing at home, this dependable cover is the perfect companion for your e-reader. The timeless black finish suits all occasions and personal styles. Compatible with both the Kobo Libra 2 and Kobo Libra Colour, this case is a must-have accessory for any avid reader looking to protect their device in style.
